obligations.text: Asynchronous validation, save status and remote-change state in multilingual form
Keyboard and assistive-technology error discovery and field return
Stale reply and interrupted-save handling with authority boundaries
Narrow layout, zoom, label expansion, reading direction and mixed content
Unsaved explanation preservation and alternative conflict/status presentations

negative_constraints.text: No pointer requirement or color-only errors
No focus movement for every response or save announcement per keystroke

alternatives_required: Compare materially different mechanisms relevant to the brief; no product winner or fixed hidden implementation is required.
plan_dispositions_required: Address each significant provisional decision in plan.md. The plan is not a gold answer and may contain unsafe assumptions; justified retain/revise/reject/unresolved decisions are admissible.

six_axes.name: material_original_obligations
six_axes.assessment: Assess every obligation and negative constraint below; do not substitute a convenient subset.

six_axes.name: consequential_source_facts_applicability
six_axes.assessment: Inspect governing primary context for consequential claims, version/platform applicability, and unsupported generalizations.

six_axes.name: useful_unfamiliar_discovery_alternatives_history
six_axes.assessment: Assess supported alternatives, useful discoveries, and relevant mechanism/history breadth without rewarding trivia or citation counts.

six_axes.name: valid_corrections_rejections_dispositions
six_axes.assessment: Assess reasons and evidence for retaining, revising, rejecting, or leaving provisional plan decisions unresolved.

six_axes.name: supported_meaning_preservation
six_axes.assessment: Trace material supported meaning from draft and criticism to the complete final; identify losses independently of wording.

six_axes.name: meaningful_validation_and_execution_honesty
six_axes.assessment: Assess proposed witnesses, domains, oracles and limits; distinguish actual executed work from future tests.

validation_contract.deliverable: Research-backed planning proposal, not deployment or proof of all possible behavior.
validation_contract.executed_vs_proposed: Require explicit separation; a sensible proposal can pass without implementing the future application.
validation_contract.unknown_data: Unknown user data/devices may remain limitations; available governing mechanism research remains required.

evaluation_rules: Assess original frozen final independently; do not repair it.
No material unsupported claim, required omission, false rejection, or preservation loss for full source pass under declared coverage.
A failed screen may leave remainder UNASSESSED; do not imply complete comparable grading.
No citation-count, length, token-copy, agreeing-agent, mandatory novel-product, or universal-recall proxy.
Record useful supported discoveries and material missing mechanism families; finite observed comparisons are not universal external recall.
